title: FNAF Door Slam
blurb: Heavy steel comes down fast. It is the single most expensive sound in Five Nights at Freddy's. The 2014 original gave you two doors and a power meter that drains faster the more you use them, turning this clank into a running cost-benefit calculation. Is Bonnie actually out there, or have you just thrown away eight percent of your night? Long-time players can hear the difference between a confident slam and a panicked one. Perfect for shutting a conversation down hard, with visible consequences for everyone involved.
origin: The security door closing in Five Nights at Freddy's (2014).
